programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying (1967)

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Nicholas Angel is an unstoppable cop who, with the help of his bumbling partner, delivers some big-city justice in a small, quiet town.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Seal Team Six: The Raid on Osama Bin Laden
programme.desc: When the rumored whereabouts of Osama bin Laden are revealed, the CIA readies a team of seasoned US Navy SEALs for the mission of a lifetime.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: The Final Girls
programme.desc: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: A sassy, confident woman must use all her wiles to have any hope of bringing her man back...while keeping her pride intact.

programme.title: How Stella Got Her Groove Back
programme.desc: Stella's vacation to Jamaica takes a hot and steamy turn when she encounters a young islander.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
programme.desc: In 18th-century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent to the Gevaudan province at the king's behest to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

programme.title: District B13
programme.desc: An elite cop (Cyril Raffaelli) and a former thug (David Belle) attempt to defuse a bomb and foil a terrorist attack inside a lawless, sealed-off ghetto in Paris. Written and produced by Luc Besson. Subtitled.

programme.title: District 13: Ultimatum
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, two vigilantes (Cyril Raffaelli and David Belle) return to the outer-Paris ghetto of District 13 to fight crime and corruption. Written and produced by Luc Besson. Subtitled.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: After providing inspiration to Will Shakespeare, his case of writer's block cured, and a taste for romance rekindled by the mysterious Lady Viola. Gwyneth Paltrow, Joseph Fiennes, Ben Affleck, and Dame Judi Dench star in this Best Picture winner.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet (2013)
programme.desc: Adapted by Julian Fellowes (Downtown Abbey) from the play by William Shakespeare.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: The Limey
programme.desc: Upon his release from prison, an extremely volatile and dangerous ex-con travels from England to Los Angeles to find the man he considers responsible for his estranged daughter's "accidental" death.

programme.title: Side Effects
programme.desc: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

programme.title: U Turn
programme.desc: A small-time gambler stranded in a desert mining town is drawn into a twisted game with deadly stakes. Stars Sean Penn, Jennifer Lopez, and Nick Nolte.

programme.title: The Iron Claw
programme.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers (Zac Efron, Jeremy Allen White, and Harris Dickinson), who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programme.title: Machine Gun Preacher
programme.desc: Sam Childers is a former drug-dealing, biker, tough guy who found God and becomes a crusader for hundreds of Sudanese children who've been forced to become soldiers.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: End of the Rope
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Sheriff Jacobson and Attorney Taylor investigate the disappearance of the Haven Family while facing a town bent on vengeance against suspect Charles Bannon.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Mean Girls (2024)
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school, when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: When Beca joins the all-girl a capella singing group The Bellas, she pushes them to change up their repertoire as they climb their way to the top.

programme.title: The Innkeepers
programme.desc: After over one hundred years of service, The Yankee Pedlar Inn is shutting its doors for good. The last remaining employees - Claire and Luke - are determined to uncover proof of what many believe to be one of New England's most haunted hotels.

programme.title: Girl on the Third Floor
programme.desc: Don Koch (Phil "CM Punk" Brooks) tries to renovate a rundown house with a sordid history for his growing family, only to learn that the house has other plans.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: The Golden Child
programme.desc: As ‘The Chosen One’, Murphy’s on a madcap mission to save The Golden Child, a youth with mystical powers who’s been abducted by an evil cult.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Without A Paddle
programme.desc: Seth Green, Matthew Lillard and Dax Shepard star in this offbeat comedy as childhood friends whose lives have drifted apart but must reunite following the sudden death of a fourth friend.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Nacho Libre

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)

programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: Seal Team Six: The Raid on Osama Bin Laden

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Armored

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Silent Hill
programme.desc: Based on the best-selling horror action game, Silent Hill stars Radha Mitchell (Man on Fire) as Rose, a desperate mother who takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment. Rating: R

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Two Can Play That Game
programme.desc: A sassy, confident woman must use all her wiles to have any hope of bringing her man back...while keeping her pride intact.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job, so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

programme.title: District 13: Ultimatum
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, two vigilantes (Cyril Raffaelli and David Belle) return to the outer-Paris ghetto of District 13 to fight crime and corruption. Written and produced by Luc Besson. Subtitled.

programme.title: Ong Bak
programme.desc: Raised by monks who taught him the Thai martial art of muay thai, Ting (Tony Jaa) is sent to Bangkok to retrieve the stolen head of the town's statue of the Buddha.

programme.title: The Protector
programme.desc: Kham, a young fighter must go to Australia to retrieve his stolen elephant. He must take on a gang led by two deadly bodyguards and an evil woman.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Enter the world of 1970s TV news, where Ron Burgundy and his loyal Channel 4 News Team are San Diego's #1 rated news source. All is well in their male-dominated world of news until rising star reporter Veronica Corningstone turns it upside down.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc: In a tale of love lost and found again, two ordinary people are rendered extraordinary by the strength, power, and beauty of true love.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Emma is a mischievous beauty who sets up her single friends, making a hilariously tangled mess of their lives until she herself falls in love. Gwyneth Paltrow stars in this beloved adaptation of Jane Austen's novel.

programme.title: Bounce (2000)
programme.desc: Buddy (Ben Affleck) is a smooth-talking ad executive enjoying a high-powered career. When a sudden twist of fate changes everything, it leads him into a head-over-heels in love affair with a recently widowed woman named Abby (Gwyneth Paltrow).

programme.title: U Turn
programme.desc: A small-time gambler stranded in a desert mining town is drawn into a twisted game with deadly stakes. Stars Sean Penn, Jennifer Lopez, and Nick Nolte.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Double Jeopardy
programme.desc: Libby Parsons, who discovers that the husband she’s convicted of murdering staged his own “death” and framed her for the crime. Released on parole, she skips town to find him–and that puts parole officer Travis Lehman on her trail.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Iron Claw
programme.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers (Zac Efron, Jeremy Allen White, and Harris Dickinson), who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programme.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
programme.desc: A small-town marshal, tormented by the puzzling conditions that surround him, is forced to confront his demons at an unexpected and untraditional 'family reunion'.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: On a mission to protect Earth, the battle-scarred and broken Bumblebee is found and repaired by a teenager named Charlie. They must work together to save the planet from the evil Decepticons in this action-packed adventure for the whole family.

programme.title: Pitch Perfect
programme.desc: When Beca joins the all-girl a capella singing group The Bellas, she pushes them to change up their repertoire as they climb their way to the top.

programme.title: John Tucker Must Die
programme.desc: Cheerleaders use a newcomer to exact revenge on their cheating boyfriend.

programme.title: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
programme.desc: Two friends try to reinvent themselves to impress old classmates.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: A police officer (Mary J. Blige) investigating a fellow officer's murder discovers an evil spirit targeting the cops in her unit, uncovering a sinister secret surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth in this intense action thriller.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: Crocodile Dundee
programme.desc: Michael J. Crocodile Dundee is a free-spirited Australian who hunts crocodiles with his bare hands, stares down giant water buffaloes, and drinks mere mortals under the table.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze and Jennifer Grey star in this spirit-lifting story about a summer love affair between a naïve 17-year-old girl and a charismatic dance instructor at a Catskills hotel. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Orange County
programme.desc: Shaun is content to be a bright but unfocused surf slacker until the day he discovers a novel by acclaimed author Martin Skinner. Inspired, he suddenly leaves Orange County to study creative writing at Stanford University.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: My Blue Heaven
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Rick Moranis, and Joan Cusack star as a silver-tongued mobster forced into the witness protection program; the FBI agent intent on keeping his witness alive to testify; and the district attorney driven to desperate measures.

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Major League
programme.desc: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians threatens to move the team unless they deliver immediate results. She then fills the roster with has-beens to guarantee their failure. But the team miraculously rallies together and starts to win.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: 2 Days in the Valley
programme.desc: Take one wrong turn in life and who knows where you'll end up? For Becky, it's waking up next to her murdered ex-husband.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman (Rainman) plays the likable graduate student and marathon runner of the title, unwillingly trapped in a killing game of intrigue involving a Nazi fugitive, Christian Szell.

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

programme.title: Saturday Night Fever
programme.desc: John Travolta performs as the troubled Tony Manero - Brooklyn paint store clerk by day and undisputed king of the dance floor by night. A powerful and provocative urban tragedy that carries as much significance today as it did in 1977.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future for all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage and Michael Peña star as two New York City Port Authority policemen who were trapped in the rubble of September 11, 2001.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated but bored tycoon who pulls off a bank heist so stunning that even Boston's finest are baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek insurance investigator out to bring him in but who, ultimately, falls in love with him.

programme.title: The Reivers
programme.desc: From the Pulitzer Prize-Winning novel by William Faulkner, Steve McQueen stars in the story of a Mississippi boy who drives to Memphis with two rascals in his family's new car—a 1905 Winton Flyer.

programme.title: 12 Angry Men
programme.desc: Eleven jurors are convinced that the defendant is guilty of murder. The twelfth has no doubt of his innocence. How can this one man steer the others toward the same conclusion? Henry Fonda and Lee J. Cobb lead the all-star cast in this classic!

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programme.title: Urban Legend
programme.desc: When New England college student Natalie finds herself at the center of a series of sadistic murders seemingly inspired by urban legends, she resolves to find the truth about Pendleton's own legend. Rated: R

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: From the creators of SCREAM, comes an even more frightening and undeniably more fun cut of CURSED, in which an LA werewolf changes the lives of three young adults who, after being mauled by the beast, must kill the one who started it all.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: When his daughter goes missing, a police negotiator (Louis Koo) teams with local police (Tony Jaa) to find her, but instead finds himself embroiled in a web of corruption and violence in this explosive thriller from director Wilson Yip.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Striking Rescue
programme.desc: Tony Jaa is in top form as Bai An, a muay thai expert seeking revenge against the men who brutally murdered his wife and child. Jaa dominates the screen with powerful flying knees and elbows, proving he’s still one of the best there is.

programme.title: Semi-Pro
programme.desc: Will Ferrell and Woody Harrelson take on the world of pro basketball in this hilarious tale of the mythical Flint Michigan Tropics owner, coach, and star player, Jackie Moon, and his quest to take his team all the way to league champions!

programme.title: Billy Madison
programme.desc: 27-year-old Billy Madison must repeat all 12 grades of school to earn his father's respect and prove he has what it takes to run the family business.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life into romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Country Strong
programme.desc: A fallen country star strives to resurrect her ailing career with a little help from her supportive husband, an ambitious young songwriter, and an emerging country artist with a rapidly growing fan base.

programme.title: Shakespeare in Love
programme.desc: After providing inspiration to Will Shakespeare, his case of writer's block cured, and a taste for romance rekindled by the mysterious Lady Viola. Gwyneth Paltrow, Joseph Fiennes, Ben Affleck, and Dame Judi Dench star in this Best Picture winner.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Courtroom thriller about a slick, hotshot lawyer (Richard Gere) who takes the seemingly unwinnable case of a young altar boy (Edward Norton) accused of murdering an eminent catholic priest.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Johnny Depp is Ichabod Crane, an investigator determined to stop the murderous Headless Horseman.

programme.title: Under the Silver Lake
programme.desc: When his beautiful, mysterious neighbor disappears without a trace, Sam (Andrew Garfield) tries to find the parties responsible, unraveling a string of strange crimes, unsolved murders, & bizarre coincidences in his East L.A. neighborhood.

programme.title: Good Will Hunting
programme.desc: The hit Oscar-winning drama which launched the careers of Matt Damon and Ben Affleck tells the tale of a headstrong, working-class genius who's failing the lessons of life, until he meets a relatable psychology professor (Robin Williams).

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: When Shelley gets kicked out of the mansion, she's lost in the wilds of Beverly Hills until she stumbles upon the sorriest sorority on campus. Now it's up to her to spruce up the girls and heat up the Zeta house before the University shuts them down.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Mean Girls (2024)
programme.desc: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school, when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.

programme.title: Alma & the Wolf
programme.desc: After a violent animal attack, paranoia spreads through Spiral Creek. But when Deputy Ren Accord gets too close, his son vanishes, and reality begins to fracture.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Susan
programme.desc: A bored New Jersey suburban housewife's fascination with a kooky character she's read about in the personal columns leads to her being mistaken for the woman herself.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Taking care of Arnie is mostly Gilbert's task, which can be pretty demanding, at least while you are working at the local grocery store.

programme.title: The Legend of Bagger Vance
programme.desc: A disillusioned war veteran, Rannulph Junah, agrees to play a game of golf. He finds the game futile until his caddy, Bagger Vance, teaches him the secret of the authentic golf stroke.

programme.title: Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: In these intertwined tales, a universe of unlikely and reluctant heroes try to do the right thing in a city that refuses to care.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: A struggling screenwriter inadvertently becomes entangled in the Los Angeles criminal underworld after his oddball friends kidnap a gangster's beloved Shih Tzu.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Single White Female
programme.desc: SWF seeks female to share apt in West 70s. Non-smoker, professional preferred. An innocent want ad opens the door to murderous, unrelenting terror in this pulse-pounding psychological shocker starring Bridget Fonda and Jennifer Jason Leigh. Rated: R

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: Sizzingly sexy Madonna leads a star-filled cast in this erotic thriller as a woman accused of killing a wealthy, elderly man through her insatiable sexual prowess.

programme.title: Curdled
programme.desc: A young woman obsessed with violent crimes becomes an employee of the Post-Forensic Cleaning Service. William Baldwin, Angela Jones, Lois Chiles, Barry Corbin, Daisy Fuentes and Kelly Preston star in this dark comic thriller.

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino delivers an iconic cast of characters in PULP FICTION, a wildly entertaining tale of violence and redemption. John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, and Bruce Willis star in this pop culture phenomenon.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (1974)
programme.desc: In this rough-and tumble movie, actually filmed on-location at the Georgia State Prison, the cons are the heroes and the guards are the heavies.

programme.title: Heaven Can Wait
programme.desc: Heaven Can Wait is a romantic fantasy about Joe Pendleton, a Los Angeles Rams quarterback who is accidentally summoned to Heaven by an overly zealous celestial escort.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: Street Fighter (1994)
programme.desc: Based on the popular video game, this adventure stars martial arts star Jean-Claude Van Damme as a commando leading an elite team of street fighters against the forces of an evil general.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnam soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf and Michelle Monaghan star as two strangers trying to escape danger when they are ripped from their ordinary lives and 'activated' as part of a hightech assassination plot.

programme.title: Equilibrium
programme.desc: In the future, mankind has outlawed the things that trigger emotion-literature, music, and art. To uphold the law, a special breed of police is assigned to eliminate all transgressors. Christian Bale stars in this awesome high-tech action thriller.

programme.title: The Poughkeepsie Tapes
programme.desc: When hundreds of videotapes showing torture, murder, and dismemberment are found in an abandoned house, they reveal a serial killer's decade-long reign of terror and become the most disturbing collection of evidence homicide detectives have ever seen.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Three men are disenchanted with life and try to recapture their college days.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Chili Palmer in this sequel to "Be Cool." With an all-star cast that includes Uma Thurman and The Rock, "Be Cool" is the hilarious tale about a gangster-turned-music-mogul...and what it takes to be number one with a bullet!

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: A Hip Hop Story
programme.desc: A pioneer of the culture joins forces with a few of rap music's elite performers to attempt to save hip hop.

programme.title: Fear of a Black Hat
programme.desc: A mockumentary chronicling the rise and fall of NWH, a not particularly talented--or particularly bright but always controversial--hip-hop group.

programme.title: Star Trek VIII: First Contact
programme.desc: They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the federation plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that just happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Just Go with It
programme.desc: After telling his girlfriend that he's married as a means of avoiding real commitment, a plastic surgeon must recruit a fake family to prove his honesty.

programme.title: Tropic Thunder
programme.desc: Ben Stiller, Jack Black and Robert Downey Jr. lead an ensemble cast in 'Tropic Thunder,' an action comedy about a group of self-absorbed actors who set out to make the most expensive war film.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: Truman doesn’t realize that his quaint hometown is a giant studio set run by a visionary producer/director/creator (Ed Harris), that folks living and working there are Hollywood actors, that even his incessantly bubbly wife is a contract player.

programme.title: Creed
programme.desc: Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born. But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical, yet gratuitous, cameos with thrillers, blockbusters, and pop-culture in general getting their best goosing yet.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: When Malcolm takes the plunge and lets his girlfriend Keisha move into his house, he senses they're not alone. Videotaping a series of paranormal events, Malcolm is shocked to discover the love of his life is demonically possessed by an evil spirit.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: Malcolm, after exorcising the demons of his ex, is starting fresh with his new girlfriend and her two kids. After moving into their dream home, Malcolm is once again plagued by bizarre paranormal events.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: Hangman's Daughter
programme.desc: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this prequel to the From Dusk Till Dawn series finds outlaw Johnny Madrid on the run from the hangman, with the hangman's daughter Esmeralda by his side. Together they are faced with the fight of their lives.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: A Better Life

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Imagina tener control z en una película de terror. Los protagonistas pagarían la luz a tiempo y no abrirían la puerta donde está el asesino, pero entonces no habría película. Disfruta estos sketches de miedo para que te mueras de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Existen situaciones peores que la muerte. Como andar de fiesta y descubrir 20 llamadas perdidas de tu mamá. Mira el episodio de hoy y disfruta con estas situaciones para morir de la risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Contrario a lo que muchos piensan, la vida sí es como en las películas. Pero una película de bajo presupuesto. Dale play al episodio y se le estrella de tu propio película... bueno el extra del fondo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Has pensado que pasaría si la realidad se mezclara con la ficción? Mira estos sketches y descúbrelo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: El secreto de la vida es saber mezclar. Hay mezclas clásicas pero también existen mezclas prohibidas como la pizza con piña, o vacilarte a tu prima. Las mezclas de hoy son igual de extrañas, pero te prometemos que van a sacarte una risa.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Hoy queremos ofrecerte un escape de la realidad. Dale un giro a la normalidad con estos 6 sketches y diviértete viendo como sería tu día a día si estuvieras dentro de una película. Y no, el nopor no cuenta como película. Dale play.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: ¿Quieres identificar si eres la tóxica de tu relación? En este episodio repasaremos las diferentes etapas de los noviazgos. Sí ves a tu novio en algún sketch ¡sal de ahí amiga y date cuenta! Y si no, pues ya sabemos quién es el problema.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Si estás buscando la forma de terminar con tu novio, en este episodio te traemos algunas ideas. Dale play a estos 6 sketches y llénate de inspiración, eso sí, bajo tu propio riesgo.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: La vida en pareja y la familia feliz no es lo que muchos te pintan, porque si estar casado es complicado ¡imagínate con un hijo, o con dos, o con tres! Si necesitas ayuda planificando tu vida familiar, dale play a este episodio.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: Entonces quieres declararte a la chica que te gusta, pero tranquilo... lo peor está por venir. Dale play al episodio para relajarte y disfrutar de lo que te queda de soledad... digo... soltería.

programme.title: Enchufe.TV
programme.desc: La peor mentira que te dijeron sobre el sexo es que va a ser perfecto. En la vida real no es como en las películas, y aún así, es bien chévere. Dale play al episodio de hoy y ríete de las situaciones incómodas que te pasarían durante el delicioso.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean adopta un misterioso animal rosado perdido. ¿Qué es esta cosa rosa y de dónde vino? Ninguna enciclopedia parece resolver el misterio sobre la identidad de la criatura. Mr Bean deberá insistir hasta encontrar una respuesta.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Irma Gobb tendrá una cena romántica junto a Mr. Bean, pero el no está del todo preparado. Al quedarse dormido en el baño mientras el pollo se cocina en el horno, Mr Bean debe ingeniárselas para tener lista la cena. Un invitado sorpresa tiene la solución.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean muerde un pedazo de palomitas de maíz, lo que le causa mucho dolor. Él piensa que al sacar su diente doloroso, resolverá sus problemas. Quitársela el mismo parece no dar solución y por eso deberá ir al dentista

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr. Bean salva a un gatito de un árbol. La prensa y el dueño del gatito llegan a su puerta para tomar una fotografía, pero el cabello de Bean está desordenado, por lo que decide cortarse el pelo."

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean quiere ver un programa en la televisión, pero los vecinos no mantendrán el ruido bajo. No hay lugar en su casa para escapar de tan odioso sonido. Bean comienza a tener pensamientos de venganza.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Luego de un infortunado accidente, Mr Bean debe reemplazar al gato tuerto de su vecina. Sin embargo en sus reiterados intentos por limpiar el salón, Bean no encuentra manera de controlar al gato.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Ir a la tienda por provisiones se convierte en una pesadilla cuando una interminable lista de compras y un carrito aplastado con una rueda torcida conspiran para arruinar su día. Por lo que Mr. Bean decide construir un súper carrito de supermercado.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean lleva a su casa una urraca herida y pronto se da cuenta de que le gusta coleccionar cosas brillantes que toma de las casas vecinas. Pero adivinen quién tiene la culpa...

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean pierde su barco embotellado, que queda atrapado en el camión del lechero. Lo busca de manera frenética, solo para verlo desaparecer en la lechería local, entre otras botellas. Una misión imposible.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Durante una visita a la Galería Nacional de Londres, Mr Bean es testigo del robo de una importante obra de arte. Sabueso que es, persigue al culpable a través del Canal hacia París. Le esperan muchos obstáculos.

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated
programme.desc: Mr Bean hace un nuevo amigo japones cuando visita el Museo de la Tecnología. El niño posee algo que impresiona tanto a Bean que intentará arruinar su diversión

programme.title: Mr Bean Animated

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Sid construye un muñeco vudú del director Wartz y jura venganza, pero cuando el Director desaparece Sid no deja de pensar que fue su culpa. / Arnold y Eugene quedan atrapados en una montaña rusa.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Se acerca el cumpleaños número 81 del Abuelo, el cumpleaños donde todos los hombres de la familia mueren. / Helga y Miriam tienen un viaje en auto no muy agradable.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Lila comienza a gustarle Arnold / Luego que el Tormenta Malva de Eugene y el Vengador Oscuro de Arnold, Sid y Stinky son destruidos en las preliminares del torneo Grand Prix, deciden combinarlos en un sólo auto para las finales

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold y Helga se escapan de sus respectivas familias ya que desean pasar un día de acción de gracias normal, cosa que ninguna de las familias tiene.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Arnold, cansado que Helga siempre se burle de él en la escuela, le pide consejo al Abuelo acerca de lo que debe hacer. / Arnold es el encargado del entretenimiento en el baile anual de la escuela y le pide a Dino Spumoni que cante en él.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: Helga tiene su propio número de entretenimiento, hacer imitaciones bastante buenas de los demás. / Los chicos se quedan atrapados en la escuela cuando una tormenta inunda las calles.

programme.title: Hey Arnold! LT
programme.desc: La clase del Señor Simmons hará la obra anual de la escuela, este año él eligió la obra Romeo y Julieta, y cuando Helga se entera que Arnold hará a Romeo, ella hará hasta lo imposible por quedarse con el papel de Julieta.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y el grupo se reúnen con un general del Reino de la Tierra que quiere usar el poderoso "Estado Avatar" de Aang como un arma para derrotar a la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En su camino a Omashu, los niños conocen a un grupo de nómadas que les muestran un atajo a través de la "Cueva de los Enamorados". Pero cuando se pierden,deben confiar en el amor para superar la maldición y escapar de los túneles

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños vuelven a Omashu para que Aang pueda aprender del Rey Bumi a controlar la tierra. Pero cuando llegan allí, se sorprenden al descubrir que ahora, la ciudad está en manos de la Nación del Fuego.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando los niños terminan en un pantano misterioso y extraño, sus temores quedan expuestos. Aang aprende a estar "conectado a la Tierra " gracias a un profesor inesperado.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y sus amigos descubren un pueblo que celebra el "Día del Avatar". Pero cuando descubren que es un festival anti-Avatar causado por algo que hizo Aang en su pasado, Aang decide limpiar el nombre del Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En búsqueda de un Maestro Tierra, los niños van a un torneo que destaca varios maestros poderosos. Allí, conocen a Toph, una ciega pero potente Maestra Tierra. Después de ver su estilo, Aang quiere que Toph le enseñe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Después de una pelea con su tío, Zuko viaja solo al Reino Tierra donde conoce a un chico y se une a él. Mientras tanto, el príncipe es perseguido por los recuerdos de su propia juventud.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños son perseguidos sin descanso por una máquina misteriosa, lo cual crea en ellos un nivel de agotamiento tan alto que terminan desesperados.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Cuando Aang falla una y otra vez al tratar de aprender a controlar la tierra conToph, se pregunta si el problema es él o su maestra. Mientras tanto, Sokka se mete en problemas.

programme.title: Una fiesta salvaje
programme.desc: El chico más popular del campus conoce a una hermosa periodista que le hace darse cuenta de que tal vez tiene miedo de graduarse.

programme.title: Las Voces
programme.desc: Jerry es un tipo alegre que trabaja en una fabrica de bañeras y tiene un encanto poco convencional. Con la ayuda de su psiquiatra, golpea a un compañero de trabajo. Pero la relacion toma un giro inesperado y asesino despues de que ella lo invita a salir.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: El Aro
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Tomoko Oishi, una pariente reportera, Reiko Asakawa , escucha historias de un video que mata a cualquiera que lo ve una semana después de verlo.

programme.title: Un Saco de Canicas
programme.desc: Dos niños hermanos judíos huyen a través de Francia durante la ocupación alemana, en plena Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Falsa Identidad
programme.desc: James Franco y Jonah Hill protagonizan este tenso thriller sobre un hombre acusado de asesinar a toda su familia y el desacreditado reportero de periódico que afirma ser, hasta que es capturado.

programme.title: Fronteras Del Alma
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes forman un vínculo mientras enfrentan crisis extraordinarias en sus respectivas familias.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Esta producción satírica presenta a un grupo de huérfanos que se embarca en diversas aventuras.

programme.title: What's Your Number?
programme.desc: Por miedo a no tener un amor verdadero, Ally Darling busca al mejor ex de su vida.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan disfraza a Kel de mujer para que se haga pasar por su esposa, y así poder participar de un programa de televisión para ganar una casa.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: A pesar de que L aún sospecha, Light y Misa (sus recuerdos de haber sido Kira han sido borrados) regresan al cuartel donde Light se da cuenta de una extraña conección entre los recientes asesinatos de Kira y el Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Matsuda el elemento del cuerpo especial encargado de vigilar a Misa, está ansioso por sobresalir, mientras está en una misión con Misa, decide husmear por su cuenta en el cuartel del Grupo Yotsuba.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: El equipo de L descubre que el Grupo Yotsuba se reúne en secreto para discutir la eliminación de individuos que son problemáticos para su compañía, concluyen que Kira debe ser uno de los 8 ejecutivos. ¿Podrá Light hacerse pasar por L?

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: El Grupo Yotsuba contrata a Eraldo Coil para revelar la identidad de L, también deciden usar a Misa Amane como vocera de sus comerciales televisivos. Durante la entrevista Rem se pone en contacto con ella y le revela el pasado que había olvidado.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Misa logra encontrar la identidad de Kira dentro del Grupo Yotsuba: Higuchi, L desarrolla un plan para llevar a Higuchi a las instalaciones de Sakura TV, donde está transmitiendo un especial de Kira que presentará a un testigo con una identidad oculta.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Higuchi del Grupo Yotsuba, trata de asesinar a Matsuda del cuerpo especial y se sorprende cuando este no muere, para averiguar su verdadero nombre Higuchi hace un trato con Rem para obtener “los ojos”.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Higuchi es capturado y cuenta a los investigadores todo sobre el Death Note, L deduce que debe haber más de dos libretas y declara que el caso sigue abierto, Light que esta sentado a su lado toca la libreta...

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light ha recobrado sus recuerdos, entonces ordena a Misa que retome los asesinatos como Kira, El Shinigami Rem se da cuenta que todo va de acuerdo al plan de Light y que L arrestará a Misa como Kira a menos de que Rem actúe rápidamente.

programme.title: Death Note
programme.desc: Light ha removido a todos los estorbos de su camino, y está cerca de alcanzar su mundo perfecto, por solicitud del equipo de investigación secretamente se convierte en el nuevo L. El mundo se dirige a una era obscura bajo el dominio de Kira.

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.title: Captain Tsubasa: Junior Youth Arc

programme.desc: Aang busca a Appa y Katara se esfuerza por mantenerlos a todos juntos para que puedan sobrevivir en el vasto desierto. Mientras tanto, Zuko y su tío buscan ayuda de una antigua sociedad secreta.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En vez de tomar el camino más fácil a Ba Sing Se, los niños deciden ayudar a una familia de refugiados a pasar a través del peligroso "Paso de la Serpiente".

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang descubre un taladro gigante de la Nación del Fuego que va en dirección a Ba Sing Se y los niños deben detenerlo antes de que destruya la gran muralla que protege a la ciudad de una invasión.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang y los niños llegan finalmente a Ba Sing Se a ver al rey de la tierra, sólo para descubrir que hay unas fuerzas misteriosas dentro de la ciudad que están conspirando para detenerlos.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Este episodio cuenta las diferentes aventuras que viven los personajes en Ba Sing Se. Se divide en varios cuentos: Katara y Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko y Momo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: En este episodio vamos atrás en el tiempo hasta el momento en el que Appa fue capturado. Nos enteraremos de qué pasó exactamente con él, dónde ha estado todo este tiempo y ¡dónde está ahora!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Mientras buscan a Appa, los niños se encuentran con Jet, pero no están seguros si deben confiar en él o no. Mientras tanto, Zuko también decide buscar a Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los chicos luchan contra Long Feng y los Dai Li para intentar demostrarle al Rey de la Tierra la gran conspiración que está teniendo lugar en su ciudad. Zuko se enferma gravemente y se enfrenta a una crisis espiritual.

programme.title: Fool Proof
programme.desc: Un ingenioso trío de ladrones disfrazados debe luchar por sus vidas y el botín cuando un verdadero criminal maestro los chantajea para que planifiquen y ejecuten un atraco de $20 millones. Protagonizada por Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: La Hora de la Verdad
programme.desc: El plan de los tres ladrones lo tiene todo para salir adelante -secuestrar al nieto de un millonario y ganar dinero fácil- pero no contaban con el carisma del bebé, lo que enternece el corazón del trío y dificulta la tarea.

programme.title: Triple Amenaza
programme.desc: La hija de un multimillonario se convierte en el objetivo de un cartel criminal peligroso y eficiente. Con lo que no contaron fue que su protección se convertiría en tres mercenarios despiadados.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: Locura de Amor en las Vegas
programme.desc: Jack y Joy, dos extraños completamente diferentes, despiertan en Las Vegas y descubren que no solamente estuvieron de suerte, ¡sino que se casaron!

programme.title: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: Un estudiante de secundaria se enamora de su vecina, una hermosa actriz pornográfica.

programme.title: El Aro
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de Tomoko Oishi, una pariente reportera, Reiko Asakawa , escucha historias de un video que mata a cualquiera que lo ve una semana después de verlo.

programme.title: Demencia
programme.desc: Una nueva versión del video de 1982 "Unhinged". Cuatro mejores amigas deciden hacer un viaje por las carreteras secundarias de Inglaterra, cuando, en su camino, un secreto mortal obliga a las chicas a quedar atrapadas en el bosque.

programme.title: Webcam Fantasma
programme.desc: Nate, en arresto domiciliario y acusado de abuso sexual, tiene una cita virtual con Mia, quien es asesinada en línea. Atrapado en casa, Nate debe averiguar si es real o solo un engaño.

programme.title: La Invocación
programme.desc: Akane es una maestra que escucha de sus alumnos el rumor de que hay imágenes de alguien suicidándose en Internet. Estas imágenes llevan a quienes también las ven a suicidarse.

programme.title: Fronteras Del Alma
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes forman un vínculo mientras enfrentan crisis extraordinarias en sus respectivas familias.

programme.title: El Orfanato
programme.desc: A principios del siglo XX, la espeluznante verdad que se esconde tras un orfanato sale a la luz cuando sus niños comienzan a rebelarse.

programme.title: El Impostor
programme.desc: Julius invita a sus colegas a un viaje en velero en el barco de su familia aristocr�tica, pero algo sale mal. Julius no es quien parece ser.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Un hombre cegado por unos residuos tóxicos, que también han potenciado el resto de sus sentidos, lucha contra el crimen como un acrobático superhéroe de las artes marciales.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra tras recuperarse de las mortales heridas sufridas en "Daredevil", se convierte en la más peligrosa asesina del mundo.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Una pareja descubre una inquietante presencia en fotografías de un supuesto accidente.

programme.title: La Sirenita
programme.desc: El periodista Cam Harrison va a investigar la historia de una sirena. Lleva a su sobrina a esta empresa y los dos son testigos de su actuación en un circo. Cam está enamorado de la sirena y la protege cuando el dueño del circo se enfurece por su fuga.

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: Rachel Troyer es una mujer policía en la pintoresca población de Sugarcreek. Con frecuencia visita a sus tías Amish, que la criaron cuando se quedó huérfana. Cuando un vagabundo aparece con su hijo de cinco años, las bondadosas tías insisten en acogerles.

programme.title: Spymate
programme.desc: Minkey, un primate súper espía, y Mike regresan a la acción cuando Amelia es secuestrada por un científico malvado. Juntos deberán detener un experimento capaz de destruir el mundo y salvarla antes de que sea tarde.

programme.title: What's Your Number?
programme.desc: Por miedo a no tener un amor verdadero, Ally Darling busca al mejor ex de su vida.

programme.title: La boda de Jenny
programme.desc: Eddie y Rose siempre han soñado con la boda de sus hijas. Por eso, cuando Anne se casa, todos esperan que su hermana pequeña Jenny haga lo mismo. Pero cuando ella anuncia su compromiso las cosas no salen como esperaba.

programme.title: Amor a Segunda Vista
programme.desc: Alec y Megan, unos jóvenes que rondan los veintitantos años, despiertan juntos después de haber tenido una aventura de una noche. Cuando les sorprende la tormenta de nieve que azota Nueva York, se ven obligados a permanecer juntos.

programme.title: Laws Of Attraction
programme.desc: Audrey Woods y Daniel Rafferty, dos prominentes abogados de divorcio, han visto cientos de casos en los que el amor ha tomado la dirección más desastrosa, ¿acaso?

programme.title: Killer In Law
programme.desc: Melissa, una mujer felizmente casada con una hija de ocho años, invita a su suegra a vivir con ellos. Sin embargo, se da cuenta de que la abuela está desquiciada y quiere secuestrar a su nieta para reemplazar a su propio hijo muerto.

programme.title: Killer in Suburbia
programme.desc: Una madre soltera se apresura para rescatar a su hija adolscente epileptica de un grupo que se dedica a la trata de personas.

programme.title: Lejos de Casa (1989)
programme.desc: La exestrella infantil Drew Barrymore tuvo su primer rol de adolescente en este cómico thriller no convencional.

programme.title: Más allá de la muerte
programme.desc: En algún momento en el futuro, todo el mundo tiene un implante que graba cada hora de sus vidas. Alan edita este material cuando una persona muere. Sin embargo, su última película pone en peligro su vida después de que descubre un oscuro secreto.

programme.title: Locas y atrapadas
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres quedan atrapadas en un ascensor, situación que sirve para que cada una de ellas empiece a contar sus propias historias desnudando sus vidas, entre discusiones, llantos, risas y la lucha por querer salir.

programme.title: Mi angelito favorito
programme.desc: El ángel celestial X100 es enviado por Dios al sector capitalino de Villa Juana para ayudar a resolver los problemas que aquejan a República Dominicana. Dios tiene la esperanza de que el ángel logre su cometido y aprenda una lección.

programme.title: Padre se busca
programme.desc: Un hombre intenta recuperar el esperma que había donado en tiempos de necesidad. Pero descubre que es posible que tres mujeres ya estén embarazadas de su bebé

programme.title: Charro A La Fuerza
programme.desc: Clara, es una bella mujer que al fallecer sus padres se queda bajo el cuidado de su tia Balbina, ellas viven comodamente en la Ciudad de México. Pronto les cambiará la vida cuando Balbina recibe la noticia de que su padre Don Aureliano ha fallecido.

programme.title: Chucho El Roto
programme.desc: Jesus Arriaga, mejor conocido como chucho el roto, es un simple y honesto carpintero que ofrece sus servicios en la casa de la familia De Frizac, sin imaginar que se enamoraria de Matilde, la hija del dueño de tan lujosa mansion donde trabaja.

programme.title: El Siete Leguas O El Caballo De Pancho Villa
programme.desc: Pancho Villa envia un emisario al pueblo de paredones para conseguir apoyo de sus partidarios en el ataque que piensa realizar. Para ser reconocido por la persona a quien lo envia, el alcalde de paredones, le da su caballo "siete leguas" como regalo.

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Joe Braven es un humilde leñador que vive en la frontera de los Estados Unidos. Cuando es asaltado por un grupo de traficantes de drogas en la recluida cabaña donde vive, hará todo lo que puede para proteger a su familia.

programme.title: Agua Profunda
programme.desc: Black Water es una película de acción que gira en torno a un agente (Jean-Claude Van Damme) que despierta atrapado en una prisión secreta de la CIA a bordo de un submarino.

programme.title: El transportador 3
programme.desc: Frank Martin es un indiscutible especialista en entregas de alto riesgo. En esta ocasión está obligado bajo amenazas a trasladar dos voluminosas bolsas y una joven ucraniana desde Marsella hasta Odessa

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Después de ser aceptado en la Academia de la Flota Estelar, Wesley acompaña a Picard en una misión final, sólo para encontrarse luchando por mantener con vida al capitán.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: La consejera Deanna Troi pierde todos sus poderes empáticos. Ante la posibilidad de no poder recuperarlos jamás, debe iniciar el duro proceso de asimilar su nueva situación.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: La boda inminente de un amigo agrava la confusión de Data sobre los matices de los sentimientos humanos.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Un oficial cardasiano sube a bordo del Enterprise con la intención de supervisar la búsqueda de una presunta nave de la Federación que acusan de haber roto el tratado de alto el fuero entre ambas potencias.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
programme.desc: El Enterprise se dirige al planeta Ventax II, cuyos habitantes se encuentran al borde del caos, seguros de estar a punto de recibir la visita de un ser mítico llamado Ardra con el que sus antepasados firmaron un trato siglos atrás.

programme.title: Guardian Espacial: Origen
programme.desc: Dakota, el Origin Ranger, recibe la misión de viajar al pasado para impedir que el programa Space Ranger llegue a existir, una tarea cuyo impacto se extiende por toda la galaxia.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Elige la ruta para una galaxia de acción incomparable y aventura mientras el capitán Jean-Luc Picard y su tripulación de la Enterprise se enfrentan a un peligroso nuevo adversario… ¡Que parece tener un sorprendente lazo con Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek
programme.desc: El apuesto y renegado James Kirk y el igualmente joven, mitad humano y mitad Vulcano, Spock componen la incipiente tripulación de la Flota Estelar para lanzar la nave más avanzada jamás creada: el U.S.S. Enterprise.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Misterio del Látigo Negro
programme.desc: Con la misma moneda: en el pueblo de San Fernando, el comisario don Miguel, su hija Rosita y Julian, novio de ella, reciben a Roberto, que llega con su hermana enferma Laura Elena y que desea adquirir tierras del lugar.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Marca del Gavilán
programme.desc: La marca del gavilan: en San Fernand, los compadres Manuel y Jose, sicarios del gavilan, asesinan por equivocacion al viudo Pablo, padre de un bebe a quien llama su tesoro: eso le cuesta la vida.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Látigo Negro Contra los Farsantes
programme.desc: El farsante: mientras Julián está en la capital comprando ganado, para disgusto de su novia Rosita, sin saber que llega a San Fernando Rogelio, un rico hacendado.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Muerte Pasa Lista
programme.desc: Misteriosas muertes de personas y robos de ganado, llevan al latigo negro a investigar quien esta detras de todo esto, los pueblerinos de San Fernando no se sienten a gusto, en la comisaria no hacen nada por temor a que tambien les hagan algo.

programme.title: Mi perro es un robot
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo peludo de Tyler muere su padre crea un perro robot para ocupar su lugar.

programme.title: Nezha - Corriendo por la vida
programme.desc: El equipo Lions enfrenta una feroz batalla en los campeonatos de F1 con la ayuda del nuevo piloto.

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña
programme.desc: En esta aventura de la mitología nórdica, Espen "Ash Lad" embarca en una peligrosa aventura.

programme.title: Mr. Jones

programme.desc: A Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se les asigna una misión de rango B en la Tierra del Té. Allí deben proteger a los participantes de una carrera durante el ritual ceremonial del Santuario Todoroki, que se celebra cada cuatro años.

programme.title: Naruto: La Carrera Comenzó, Problema En Altamar
programme.desc: Los sirvientes del jefe piensan que Idate ha hecho que su gran festival tradicional parezca una farsa. Jirocho cree que Idate ha huido y que está planeando algo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Corre, Idate, corre! ¡La isla Nagi espera!
programme.desc: Naruto y su equipo consiguen alcanzar a Idate, pero lo encuentran herido e inconsciente cerca de Aoi.

programme.title: Naruto: La Gran Batalla Del Rayo Ondulado
programme.desc: A pesar de que Aoi intenta impedirlo, Idate continúa corriendo. Idate sigue sin confiar en nadie y se revela que, durante los Exámenes Chunin, el hermano mayor de Idate era el examinador que propuso la décima pregunta.

programme.title: Naruto: El Ultimo Esfuerzo, Un Acto Final De Desesperación
programme.desc: El jefe Jirocho espera, seguro de que Idate va a ganar. Pero Aoi, el ninja enviado por el Clan Wagarashi, se interpone en su camino.

programme.title: Naruto: La Batalla Comienza, Naruto Contra Sasuke
programme.desc: Shikamaru es ascendido a chunin y lo celebra junto con sus compañeros en un restaurante de barbacoa. En el hospital, Lee decide someterse a una operación peligrosa para reparar su cuerpo y seguir siendo un ninja.

programme.title: Naruto: Rivales Resentidos Y Vínculos Rotos

programme.title: Naruto: Una Invitación Por Parte Del Sonido

programme.title: Naruto: Formación: El Escuadrón De Rescate De Sasuke

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
programme.desc: Tras aceptar ir a buscar a Jesse, Jaden y la pandilla se encuentran viajando por un extraño y oscuro mundo en el que jugar implica arriesgar algo más que puntos de vida.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX

programme.title: One Piece - Arabasta Saga: ¡Una promesa entre hombres! Luffy y la ballena prometen verse de nuevo
programme.desc: Una vez que Crocus le cuenta a Luffy y la tripulación la historia de Laboon, Luffy decide hacer una promesa con la ballena para que deje de golpearse contra el Grand Line. Luego, conocen a un grupo de extraños que los llevará a su próximo destino.
